Academy Dropout.name: Academy Dropout
Academy Dropout.description:
The Star Academy of the Rhivan accepts students from across the world, and you can be admitted with even the barest glimmer of magical potential. Some, however, find the strict, unrelenting study unbearable and last only a short while before leaving to find their fortunes elsewhere. You likely picked up a few things, learning just enough to get by in any situation that requires magical knowledge.

You are a capable magical adept, at least in terms of knowledge, and you know many magical theories and phenomena.

Origin Stories

Find a Patron. Academy life did not suit you, and you were gently "encouraged" to resign your studies and return home. You remain determined to continue your experimentation and research independently, but that will require a patron of considerable means and resources.

Reclaim Your Name. You come from a long line of proud Star Academy graduates and full-fledged members, but you squandered that legacy in less than a year. Through poor self-application and worse attendance, you were declared truant and unceremoniously removed from the registrar. Now you must find a way to restore your honor and live up to your family's legacy.

Protect a Secret. You were an excellent student at the Star Academy, near the top of your class, until a scandal forced you to leave quietly in your second year. The academy administrators gave you a simple choice: leave of your own volition, or have the truth made public. You chose the former, but you are still haunted by what you did.

Anchorite Marine.name: Anchorite Marine
Anchorite Marine.description:
You have trained as a sailor or marine in the Cascilian Republic's Navy. This has given you a deep understanding of ships and sailing across Ember's vast seas and oceans, and you know a great deal about navigation and charts. In a pinch, you could also repair or even construct a small vessel to cross small bodies of water such as rivers or lakes. During your service, you may have engaged the Undead attempting to invade across the Golden Bay.

You understand how to operate ocean vessels of varying sizes in a limited fashion and also how to navigate the seas using charts. You may also have some knowledge of the different types of Undead and their weaknesses.

Origin Stories

Prove Mortal Strength. While serving with the Cascilian navy, you learned to trust steel and wits over miracles. A sturdy hull, a sharp blade, and a crew that does its duty are worth a thousand prayers. Now you travel among people who bend their knees to Shard Gods and trust powers they cannot understand. You mean to prove that the world turns on the strength of mortals, not the whims of eldritch beings.

Earn Your Salt. All Cascilian teenagers must undergo the "Salt-Trial," navigating a small vessel through dangerous waters alone. Though you served in the Cascilian navy, you never completed yours. Perhaps you failed, cheated, or came from a different culture and never undertook it. Either way, your shipmates never fully trusted you. You have come looking for a trial, something no true-born Cascilian could deny. 

Recover Wreckage. Currents from the Golden Bay sometimes drag broken hulls and valuable, secret Ochanic technology from the Cascilian Navy to distant lands, where they wash ashore. You have come here looking for what the sea has given up. Perhaps you seek valuable salvage, a lost shipmate's memento, Ochanic components, or the last traces of a ship that left sunward from the Golden Bay and never returned home.

Caravanner.name: Caravanner
Caravanner.description:
Trade between the many cities of Ember and across its varied and scattered cultures is often undertaken by the never-ending march of diverse and assorted overland caravans. You may have traveled long distances with a caravan in the past, learning to twirl a coin in your hand or regale a group with a tale. You are also likely to be keen-eyed, and after years of scanning the horizon for danger, you can smell trouble from a mile away.

You have a keen eye and can spot hidden dangers around you both close and far. You have a keen sense of survival and can also keep yourself alive while traveling in the wilderness.

Origin Stories

Find the Missing Caravan. A caravan you once traveled with never reached its destination. It may have carried a friend, an important parcel, or something else precious to you. You have followed the trail to an ill-governed frontier, often hostile to travelers — yet despite the danger, you felt compelled to come here and investigate the disappearance. With luck, you may recover something of what was lost.

Open a New Route. You hail from a far-off distant land, one geographically disconnected from the Arctus Plateau and the wealth of Ordain. On behalf of a foreign power, mercantile guild, or ambitious patron, you intend to forge a new formal trade route with one of the great Trading Houses.

Deliver the Last Parcel. Before parting ways with your old caravan, you were entrusted with a parcel that was never delivered. Perhaps its owner died, the destination changed hands, or the thing inside proved more trouble than it was worth. You still carry it, wrapped and sealed, waiting for the right person … or the right price.

Cindaric Initiate.name: Cindaric Initiate
Cindaric Initiate.description:
The Cindaric Sages of Ordain are well known for sending their members out into the world to teach others about the Heart of Ember and its wondrous, life-giving energy. You may have been taught by a wandering sage as a child in your homeland and always dreamt of visiting the Cindarin Temple, or perhaps your family is originally from Ordain and has a close connection to the sages through your upbringing. You are likely well-versed in religious ideas and believe strongly that the Heart of Ember is a force for good, imbuing all creatures with life and purpose. 

Your faith has granted you knowledge of the Heart of Ember, the life-imbuing energy of Lifeforce, and you may also have a strong connection to nature and the cycles of life and death.

Origin Stories

Journey to the Temple. You first learned of the Heart of Ember from a traveling Cindaric Sage, whose teachings resonated within you. In the months since, you have kept the faith as best you can, studying the scant information that reached your homeland and sharing the Heart's beneficence with those willing to listen. Now you travel to Cindarin Temple to be formally recognized, reaffirm your devotion before the Sages, and take the first step toward becoming a sage.

Seek Out the Sanguinaries. Ever since you learned of the Sanguinaries—the heretical sister order of the Cindaric Sages, spoken of in hushed whispers—a deep disquiet has settled in your heart. It does not seem right for your brothers and sisters in faith to remain unreconciled to Cindarin Temple. The Sages call them liars and blasphemers, but you are determined to seek them out and learn their beliefs.

Honor Your Mentor. The traveling Sage who first taught you about the Heart of Ember is dead, and their mission has passed to you. You have only just begun to extol the beliefs of the Cindaric order, but you must take every opportunity to teach others about the goodness of the Heart of Ember and the Lifeforce that binds all living things together. Perform your duty, spread the faith, and you may yet prove worthy of the trust your mentor placed in you.

Cosmopolitan Fashionista.name: Cosmopolitan Fashionista
Cosmopolitan Fashionista.description:
You may have spent time in the great city of Ordain, and while you may not have been born there, you have acclimated to its bustling, cosmopolitan attitudes and trends. You may be able to gather information more easily and have a great visual memory for the people around you.  Your sense of style is impeccable, and you can recognize minute details about a person simply by studying them for a few moments. You may also be keen to immerse yourself in social events and use what you learn to your advantage. 

You understand fashion well enough to uncover personal details simply by studying what people wear. You may have a talent for intrigue, diplomacy, and making social connections. 

Origin Stories

Connect With House Salva. You have spent time abroad studying the fashions of distant lands, and look forward to returning to Ordain to share your findings. House Salva has always claimed to value new perspectives; perhaps it is time to offer yours.

Restore Your Reputation. Your name signified the hottest fashion in Ordain — for a season. Just as fast as your star rose, it dimmed, and suddenly your party invitations stopped arriving. After a brief but restorative sabbatical abroad, you feel ready to make your return, preferably in something no one else has seen before.

Become High Society. Your compulsory attendance at a relative's deathbed in a distant land has mercifully come to an end. As the memory (and smell) of travel fades, you look forward to reacquainting yourself with the high society of Ordain: its parties, its fashions, its rivalries, and its vices.

Crown Apothecary.name: Crown Apothecary
Crown Apothecary.description:
You have spent time visiting or learning from Ember's finest alchemists in the city of Crown on the island of Vita'ri. Your time there gave you deeper knowledge of the reagents, infusions, and essences needed to create potent alchemical elixirs. This knowledge helps you recognize alchemical ingredients and their properties more easily, and understand the effects of alchemically created substances.

The alchemists of Crown are renowned for infusing creations with elemental energy, heightening and enhancing their potency. This art requires significant knowledge of elementals and their capabilities. As a byproduct of your experiences in Crown, you have unusual knowledge of elementals, their types, and their inherent attributes.

Origin Stories

Find the Cure. Someone you care about is suffering from an affliction that ordinary medicine cannot treat, and even your alchemical tutors in Crown have exhausted their efforts in search of a cure. You have come to this region chasing rare ingredients, even if gathering them requires bargaining with monsters, dissecting the sick, or testing your work on yourself first.

Bottle the Storm. In Crown, you studied under alchemists who believed that elemental forces could be captured, studied, and harnessed for mortal gain. The waxing and waning of the Elemental Moons touch every corner of Ember. You intend to prove your tutors' theories in the field.

Find the Mutagen. Reports have reached Crown of a cabal of despicable alchemists on the Arctus Plateau who have concocted a rumored "mutagenic" solution that twists the body and sickens the mind. Your superiors dispatched you to track down this mutagen, recover a sample, and destroy what remains.

Abyss Attunement.name: Abyss Attunement
Abyss Attunement.description:
Your soul is vacant of resonance with Ember's cosmological forces, instead you are attuned to the unsettling pull of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.06I8t0GPggrMVnGV]{The Abyss} and its philosophical ideal of Nihilism.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Void damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberAbyssAttune abyssMarkUnmaking] action which allows you to recover Focus when you defeat a marked enemy.

  • Rank 3: Your maximum Focus is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Abyssal spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Oblivion rune. On a critical hit, recover the spell's focus cost plus 2 additional Focus, once per turn.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberAbyssAttune abyssUntethering] action which expends Heroism to deal massive Void damage to a single target.

abyssMarkUnmaking.name: Mark of Unmaking
abyssMarkUnmaking.description: Apply an Abyssal mark to a target you just critically hit within 60 feet. If you subsequently cause the creature to become @Condition[weakened], @Condition[broken], or @Condition[dead] you harvest +2 Focus. The mark persists until consumed or until you apply a new mark to a different target.
abyssMarkUnmaking.condition: You score a critical hit against an enemy.

abyssUntethering.name: Untethering
abyssUntethering.description: You assault the Fortitude of a single creature, dealing massive Void damage. On a success, the creature's Morale is immediately reduced to zero and all damage dealt applies directly towards Madness. Additionally, the target suffers the @Condition[entropy] condition for 10 rounds. This action scales with your highest ability of Strength, Toughness, or Dexterity.

Akon Attunement.name: Akon Attunement
Akon Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.3Oywe0peo57dQT9j]{Akon}, The Shattered Moon, and its philosophical ideal of Discipline.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Piercing damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberAkonAttunem akonForesight] reaction which lets you predict the outcome of a roll and recover Focus when correct.

  • Rank 3: Your Parry defense is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Akonic spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Kinesis rune. The spell automatically deals whichever physical damage type the enemy is most vulnerable to.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberAkonAttunem akonInevitability] reaction which marks an enemy and forces its strategy to be revealed at the start of each Round.

akonForesight.name: Foresight
akonForesight.description: Before any creature has acted in a combat round, verbally declare a specific prognostication: a named actor will perform a specific action and obtain a category of result, either Success or Failure. If the prognostication comes to pass you may use this reaction to recover +1 Focus.
akonForesight.condition: A creature performs the action you previously declared.

akonInevitability.name: Inevitability
akonInevitability.description: At the start of a Combat Round, before any creature has acted, you declare a single visible enemy's doom. At the beginning of each subsequent Round, before you declare your Foresight prognostication, the Gamemaster must publicly announce the strategy this creature will pursue on its Turn and commit to it unless rendered impossible.
akonInevitability.condition: At the start of a Combat Round, before any creature has acted.

Altyra Lineage.name: Altyra Lineage
Altyra Lineage.description: You are immune to the @Condition[diseased] condition which otherwise prevents you from regaining @Rule[resource.health].

tyraphicTransformation.name: Tyraphic Transformation
tyraphicTransformation.description:
You can imbue yourself with the temporary visage and capabilities of Tyraphem, assuming an otherworldly visage. While transformed, you gain the following benefits.

  • You gain resistance to Radiant damage equal to 2 times your level.

  • Your attacks deal additional Radiant damage equal to half your @Rule[ability.presence].

  • You gain +2 Boons to your use of the @Rule[skill.intimidation] skill.

You may end this transformation prior to its full duration on your turn at no cost.

Ashka Lineage.name: Ashka Lineage
Ashka Lineage.description:
Your Stride is not penalized while in water. You can hold your breath while underwater for up to twenty minutes.

You perceive the world through differences in temperature with precision, allowing you to locate creatures whose bodily temperature deviates from ambient norms. This allows you to detect creatures whose body temperatures are Gelid, Cool, Warm, or Boiling up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover and you are not @Condition[blinded] or @Condition[incapacitated]. A creature detected in this way is treated as visible for the purposes of actions which require you to see your target.

Aster.name: Aster
Aster.description: Your alteration sets you apart from others of your ancestry, You may show phsycial signs of your transformation, or your differences may lie hidden within, shaping you are at a fundamental level. No two Aster are alike, and your form is entirely your own.

Aura Attunement.name: Aura Attunement
Aura Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.smc0OuMxsxfcSdhR]{Aura}, The Hollow Moon, and its philosophical ideal of Individualism.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Electricity damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberAuraAttunem auraSlipstream] action which surrounds you with airy displacement after you move.

  • Rank 3: Your Stride is increased by 2 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Auric spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Storm rune. After casting, you recover your Free Move.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberAuraAttunem auraBoundless] action which grants flight and immunity to a range of movement-impairing conditions.

auraSlipstream.name: Slipstream
auraSlipstream.description: You create a slipstream that causes your form to shimmer with airy displacement. Your Dodge and Reflex defenses are both increased by +1 until the start of your next Turn. The slipstream collapses once you take damage from any source.
auraSlipstream.condition: You used the Move action this turn.

auraBoundless.name: Boundless
auraBoundless.description: You can fly and cannot be afflicted by the @Condition[slowed], @Condition[prone], @Condition[restrained], @Condition[staggered], @Condition[stunned], or @Condition[paralyzed] conditions for 6 Rounds. While Boundless is active, all spells you cast with the Storm rune are Empowered.

Cleansing Flame.name: Cleansing Flame
Cleansing Flame.description: You are a champion of Lumé in the perpetual war against undeath. You gain +1 Boon on any attack against enemies of the Undead type.

Constructed Companion.name: Constructed Companion
Constructed Companion.description:
You may spend 1 hour creating a tiny @UUID[Actor.oLu6qs3AYUu8eitR] from a natural material that comes from or grows in the ground, for example clay, stone, wood, or straw. The Constructed Companion is an animated construct which becomes a creature under your control, surviving for 8 hours or until it is reduced to 0 health or morale.

While the Constructed Companion is animated, you can provide it with basic verbal instructions to issue simple commands, such as "fetch a key", "stand watch", or "stack some books". If you issue no commands the Constructed Companion will do nothing other than defend itself against hostile creatures, performing the Defend action whenever appropriate. Once given an order, the Companion continues to follow that order until its task is complete or alternative instructions are given.

You may only have one Constructed Companion active at a time, creating a second companion causes the magic which animated your prior Constructed Companion to immediately fade.

constructedCompanion.name: Construct Companion
constructedCompanion.description: You spend 1 hour creating a Constructed Companion which follows your basic verbal instructions.

Cora Attunement.name: Cora Attunement
Cora Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.5pD8lxiilJJXOgoa]{Cora}, The Blasted Moon, and its philosophical ideal of Pragmatism.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Acid damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberCoraAttunem coraAftershock] reaction which knocks an attacker back when you successfully defend a melee attack.

  • Rank 3: Your Block defense is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Coran spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Earth rune. On a critical hit, all damaged enemies are @Condition[restrained] for 1 turn.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberCoraAttunem coraGraviturgicCrush] action which creates a gravitational vortex that pulls enemies inward.

coraAftershock.name: Aftershock
coraAftershock.description: You retaliate with a concussive aftershock that knocks your attacker backward 3 feet. The knockback distance is doubled if the target is @Condition[restrained] or @Condition[staggered].
coraAftershock.condition: You successfully defended an incoming melee Strike with Armor or Block.

coraGraviturgicCrush.name: Graviturgic Crush
coraGraviturgicCrush.description: You create a gravitational vortex that attacks the Fortitude of all creatures within. Those who do not resist are pulled to the center, take Empowered Bludgeoning damage, and become @Condition[staggered]. This action scales with your highest ability of Strength, Toughness, or Intellect.

Cor'ak Lineage.name: Cor'ak Lineage
Cor'ak Lineage.description: Your thick and partially-metallic hide provides natural protection from blows. While you are unarmored, you gain an @Rule[defense.armor] bonus equal to half your @Rule[ability.toughness] ability score.

crystalizeWounds.name: Crystalize Wounds
crystalizeWounds.description: When you become @Condition[weakened] or suffer damage while @Condition[weakened], a crystalline carapace forms over your body. For a short period of time you gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your @Rule[ability.toughness] modifier. You also immediately gain an amount of @Rule[resource.health] equal to two times your Level.
crystalizeWounds.condition: You become Weakened or suffer damage while Weakened.

Personalized Crafting.name: Personalized Crafting
Personalized Crafting.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Drakon Lineage.name: Drakon Lineage
Drakon Lineage.description:
You are extraordinarily resistant to the influence of Necromancy and death magic. Spells using the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeDeath0000000]{Rune of Death} have +2 Banes to their spell attack rolls against you.

You know the unique Drakonfire inflection which can be added to spells using the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeFlame0000000]{Rune of Flame}. A spell augmented with Drakonfire costs +1 @Rule[resource.heroism] to cast and is @Rule[action.deadly]. It uses your @Rule[ability.toughness] for its ability bonus if doing so is better than its ordinary scaling, and it ignores an amount of each target's Fire resistance up to your @Rule[ability.toughness] score.

Explosives Training.name: Explosives Training
Explosives Training.description: You have familiarity with explosives. When using a consumable of the Bomb type you always count as at least Trained in the relevant skill. If you are already trained in that skill, you instead gain +1 Boon to any involved checks.

Fej Lineage.name: Fej Lineage
Fej Lineage.description: Your Ancestry's resistance to Fire damage is further increased by your character Level. If you are submersed in water for longer than 6 seconds or begin your turn submersed in water you must test your resolve using the Water Aversion action.

extremeMetabolism.name: Extreme Metabolism
extremeMetabolism.description:
You activate your fiery metabolism to engage a burst of supernatural speed.

  • Your Stride increases by +2.

  • You gain a bonus to @Rule[defense.dodge] equal to half your @Rule[ability.dexterity].

  • You gain +1 to both your current and maximum @Rule[resource.action].

waterAversion.name: Water Aversion
waterAversion.description:
When submersed in water for longer than 6 seconds, or when you begin your turn submersed in water, you must test your own resolve.

ALPHA ONE: This action needs further balancing.
waterAversion.condition: Submersed in water for longer than 6 seconds.

Heart Attunement.name: Heart Attunement
Heart Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with the Lifeforce energy of the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.0anKTKgOav9sXox1]{Heart of Ember} and its philosophical ideal of Vitalism.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Corruption damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberHeartAttune heartHallow] action which marks Undead and Outsider foes for radiant retribution.

  • Rank 3: Your maximum Health is increased each level by for each attunement rank above 2 (+2 at Rank 3, +4 at Rank 4, +6 at Rank 5).

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Ember spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Life rune. The Life rune deals Radiant damage to enemies while still providing restoration to allies.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberHeartAttune heartSparkOfEmber] action which can resurrect the recently dead or banish Undead with radiant judgment.

heartHallow.name: Hallow
heartHallow.description: You leave a mark of Ember lifeforce upon the affected creature rendering it @Condition[exposed] for 1 round.
heartHallow.condition: You successfully affect an Undead or Outsider with a Strike or Spell.

heartSparkOfEmber.name: Spark of Ember
heartSparkOfEmber.description: You touch a creature that has recently died or is Undead. A target which is @Condition[dead] and has died within the last 24 hours becomes alive, receiving full Restoration to both Wounds and Health. If used against a target which is Undead, you make a Deadly attack which benefits from +6 Boons against its Fortitude, dealing Radiant damage.

Hot Tempered.name: Hot Tempered
Hot Tempered.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Hulg'run Lineage.name: Hulg'run Lineage
Hulg'run Lineage.description:
You are immune to the @Condition[asleep] condition.

You can commune with the essence of Ember when you @Rule[actions.rest]. If you are resting upon solid ground, you do not require sleep and can remain conscious. You may not engage in any strenuous activity in order to gain the benefits of the rest.

livingStone.name: Living Stone
livingStone.description:
Your form temporarily calcifies, providing enhanced protection against physical blows.

  • You gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Level + 1.

  • Your Stride is reduced by -2.

  • You are immune to the @Condition[prone] condition and cannot be involuntarily moved.

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a @Rule[action.reaction] which involves a @Rule[resource.focus] cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.

emberBlaze.name: Ember Blaze
emberBlaze.description: When you become @Condition[weakened] or sustain damage while @Condition[weakened], you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your @Rule[resource.action] and @Rule[resource.focus] pools to their maximum value.
emberBlaze.condition: You become Weakened or take damage while Weakened.

Impassioned Revelry.name: Impassioned Revelry
Impassioned Revelry.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Imperial Ambition.name: Imperial Ambition
Imperial Ambition.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Intrepid Sailor.name: Intrepid Sailor
Intrepid Sailor.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Keth Lineage.name: Keth Lineage
Keth Lineage.description:
You thrive on unpredictability and you have a penchant for turning a bad situation into an advantageous one.

  • If you fail using a Skill action, your next action gains the benefit of +1 Boon until the start of your next Turn.

  • If you miss on an Attack action, your next action gains the benefit of +1 Boon until the start of your next Turn.

suddenBite.name: Sudden Bite
suddenBite.description: In extraordinary or desperate circumstances, you can make a vicious attack with your sharp teeth. You gnash viciously with your extended jaw of sharp teeth, making a @Rule[action.natural] weapon attack with the @Rule[action.deadly] property which deals Piercing damage.

Kiska Lineage.name: Kiska Lineage
Kiska Lineage.description: You blend effortlessly into the darkness. While you stand within dim light or darkness, you gain +2 Boons to @Rule[skill.stealth] checks, including those made to @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.hide000000000000]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.sneak00000000000]{Sneak}.

nimbleLeap.name: Nimble Leap
nimbleLeap.description: You draw on a limited reserve of energy to make a spectacular bounding leap. You may immediately Jump up to three times your Stride. Movement made in this way is so sudden that it affords no opportunity for Disengagement attacks.

Kivahr Lineage.name: Kivahr Lineage
Kivahr Lineage.description:
Your body is strengthened with the lineage of giants. Your mind and your body work in harmony to solve problems and withstand physical strain.

You gain a bonus to your @Rule[defense.fortitude] and @Rule[defense.willpower] defenses equal to your Level divided by 4.

regulatedRhythm.name: Regulated Rhythm
regulatedRhythm.description:
You engage your supernatural ability to harmonize your mind and body. You enter a trance-like state which provides the following benefits at the start of your Turn.

  • You gain +1 @Rule[resource.focus].

  • If your Morale is higher than your Health, you transfer up to your @Rule[ability.presence] ability score reducing @Rule[resource.morale] and gaining @Rule[resource.health].

  • If your Health is higher than your Morale, you transfer up to your @Rule[ability.toughness] ability score, reducing @Rule[resource.health] and gaining @Rule[resource.morale].

These transfers will not cause any resource to exceed it's maximum value.

Lunar Tattoos.name: Lunar Tattoos
Lunar Tattoos.description:
Your luminous tattoos resonate with the energy of Ember's elemental moons. When one or more moons are full, you gain +2 resistance to damage of their corresponding type:

  • Aura - Electricity resistance

  • Cora - Acid resistance

  • Mayis - Cold resistance

  • Ragen - Fire resistance

  • Akon - Piercing resistance

  • Orbis - Psychic resistance

Luxarum Attunement.name: Luxarum Attunement
Luxarum Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.pPU6VZV7WFubtcSR]{Luxarum}, the Realm of Endless War and its philosophical ideal of Ambition.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Radiant damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberLuxarumAttu luxarumEternalVengeance] reaction which fills you with righteous zeal when critically struck.

  • Rank 3: Your Fortitude defense is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Luxaran spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Illumination rune. Each enemy struck is illuminated and becomes @Condition[exposed] for 1 turn.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberLuxarumAttu luxarumTyraphicCrusade] action which leaps you into the sky to deliver a radiant blast and refund actions per target damaged.

luxarumEternalVengeance.name: Eternal Vengeance
luxarumEternalVengeance.description: When you receive a critical hit from an incoming Strike or Spell, you are filled with righteous zeal and become @Condition[hastened] until the end of your next Turn.
luxarumEternalVengeance.condition: An incoming Strike or Spell critically succeeds against you.

luxarumTyraphicCrusade.name: Tyraphic Crusade
luxarumTyraphicCrusade.description: You leap into the sky, landing at a point you can see within 120 feet. All creatures within the area of a 10-foot Blast face an Empowered attack against their Reflex dealing Radiant damage. You gain +1 Action for each target that suffers damage. Damaged targets that were already @Condition[exposed] become @Condition[stunned] for 1 round. This action scales with your highest ability of Strength, Toughness, or Dexterity.

Mayis Attunement.name: Mayis Attunement
Mayis Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.RkdBtFQk7STvMbV2]{Mayis}, The Tempest Moon, and its philosophical ideal of Patience.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Cold damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberMayisAttune mayisRestorativeRedirection] reaction which redirects a resisted spell's energy to heal a nearby ally.

  • Rank 3: Your Healing Threshold is reduced by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Mayis spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Frost rune. The Frost rune provides Restoration to allies while still dealing Cold damage to enemies.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberMayisAttune mayisRestorationOfTheDeep] action which heals allies in an arcing surge and cleanses ongoing harm.

mayisRestorativeRedirection.name: Restorative Redirection
mayisRestorativeRedirection.description: When you resist an incoming Spell, you redirect a portion of the resisted spell's energy toward an ally you can see within 30 feet, providing them with Weakened restoration to whichever resource was targeted by the original spell. This action scales with your highest ability of Wisdom, Presence, or Intellect.

mayisRestorationOfTheDeep.name: Restoration of the Deep
mayisRestorationOfTheDeep.description: You unleash a surge of cleansing waters in a 30-foot ray that is 20 feet wide. Allies in the area receive Empowered restoration to their Health and are immediately cleansed of any effects which deal damage over time. This action scales with your highest ability of Wisdom, Presence, or Intellect.

Mistrust of Magic.name: Mistrust of Magic
Mistrust of Magic.description: Your watchfulness for magical influence allows you to help yourself resist malign effects. Spell attacks against you which target your Willpower defense suffer from +2 Banes.

Nir'ae Lineage.name: Nir'ae Lineage
Nir'ae Lineage.description: Your iridescent birthmarks provide you with a remarkable ability to evade or instinctually redirect hostile magic. Spell attacks against you suffer from +2 Banes.

prescientReflection.name: Prescient Reflection
prescientReflection.description:
When a spell which targets you directly is resisted with a critical failure, you can instinctually redirect the energy of the spell, causing it to instead dissipate or affect an alternative target within range of the spell other than its original caster.

The alternative target must defend against the spell instead and any effects of the spell are applied to that target instead. If no alternative target is chosen, the energy of the spell dissipates harmlessly.
prescientReflection.condition: A spell which targets you directly is resisted with a critical failure.

Orbis Attunement.name: Orbis Attunement
Orbis Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.zkmWSB32y8Fbc4UL]{Orbis}, The Spirit Moon, and its philosophical ideal of Spontaneity.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Psychic damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberOrbisAttune orbisChaoticRefraction] action which floods your next action with random Boons and Banes.

  • Rank 3: Your maximum Morale is increased each level by for each attunement rank above 2 (+2 at Rank 3, +4 at Rank 4, +6 at Rank 5).

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Orbis spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Soul rune. The Soul rune deals Psychic damage to enemies while still providing Morale restoration to allies.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberOrbisAttune orbisPandemonium] action which assails the minds of nearby enemies with maddening psychic energy.

orbisChaoticRefraction.name: Chaotic Refraction
orbisChaoticRefraction.description: You harness the unpredictable spiritual currents of Orbis to affect your next action before the end of your next Turn with spontaneous surges of fortune or misfortune. Your next action gains +1d4 Boons and +1d4-1 Banes. When consuming Chaotic Refraction against @Condition[confused] targets, only Boons apply and Banes are discarded.

orbisPandemonium.name: Pandemonium
orbisPandemonium.description: Bewildering spirits assail all enemies within the area, attacking their Willpower and inflicting Empowered Psychic damage to Morale and the @Condition[confused] condition. This action scales with your highest ability of Wisdom, Presence, or Intellect.

Passionate Trader.name: Passionate Trader
Passionate Trader.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Preeminent Survivalist.name: Preeminent Survivalist
Preeminent Survivalist.description:
You are always treated as at least Trained in both the Awareness and Wilderness skills. If you are already trained, such skill checks will be made with +1 Boon.

Additionally, you cannot be caught @Condition[unaware] unless you are Incapacitated, Deafened, or Blinded.

Primordis Attunement.name: Primordis Attunement
Primordis Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.16sqn71JsCkghaTt]{Primordis}, the Realm of Capricious Sorcery, and its philosophical ideal of Cunning.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Poison damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberPrimordisAt primordisSlipIntoShadow] action which lets you vanish into darkness when not engaged.

  • Rank 3: Your Reflex defense is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Primordial spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Illusion rune. On a critical hit, you become @Condition[invisible] until the start of your next turn.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberPrimordisAt primordisPredatorsShadow] action which strikes from invisibility for devastating poisoned damage.

primordisSlipIntoShadow.name: Slip Into Shadow
primordisSlipIntoShadow.description: Immediately after you perform the Move action, if you are within an area of darkness or dim light and not Engaged by any enemies, you momentarily slip into the shadows, becoming @Condition[invisible] until you perform a Strike or Spell action or until the end of your Turn.
primordisSlipIntoShadow.condition: Immediately after the Move action, while within an area of darkness or dim light and not Engaged by any enemies.

primordisPredatorsShadow.name: Predator's Shadow
primordisPredatorsShadow.description: While @Condition[invisible], you attack an enemy. If they do not detect you, your attack has +6 Boons and is Deadly. On a critical hit it inflicts the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 6 Rounds.

Ragen Attunement.name: Ragen Attunement
Ragen Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.LKptgmc56euSOb0G]{Ragen}, The Charred Moon, and its philosophical ideal of Directness.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Fire damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberRagenAttune ragenFurnaceBlast] reaction which retaliates with fire when you are critically struck.

  • Rank 3: Your Initiative is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Ragen spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Flame rune. If the spell would cause @Condition[burning] to any enemy, it causes @Condition[burning] to all enemies.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberRagenAttune ragenImmolatingRejuvenation] action which expends your remaining Health to burn nearby enemies and gain rapid regeneration.

ragenFurnaceBlast.name: Furnace Blast
ragenFurnaceBlast.description: When you are critically hit by a Strike or Spell, you burst forth with the intensity of Ragen's fire, making a Weakened attack against the Fortitude of all creatures within 3 feet which deals Fire damage and causes the @Condition[disoriented] condition. Like bellows stoking a flame, any damaged target that is @Condition[burning] suffers its full remaining damage-over-time immediately and is no longer @Condition[burning]. This action scales with your highest ability of Strength, Toughness, or Dexterity.
ragenFurnaceBlast.condition: You are critically hit by a Strike or Spell.

ragenImmolatingRejuvenation.name: Immolating Rejuvenation
ragenImmolatingRejuvenation.description: You draw the entirety of your inner fire into a devastating attack against the Reflex defense of nearby creatures. You are reduced to 0 Health and become @Condition[weakened]. The amount of Health you lose is divided equally among all targets in the area; each damaged target receives that share as bonus damage and suffers the @Condition[burning] condition. You gain the @Condition[mending] condition for 10 rounds. This action scales with your highest ability of Strength, Toughness, or Dexterity.

Resolute Legacy.name: Resolute Legacy
Resolute Legacy.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Ritual Cooking.name: Ritual Cooking
Ritual Cooking.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Signara Attunement.name: Signara Attunement
Signara Attunement.description:
Your soul resonates with attunement to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.3OvueRrGcFnwtnmw]{Signara}, the Realm of Insatiable Curiosity, and its philosophical ideal of Curiosity.

You gain the following benefits which improve with your attunement rank.

  • Rank 1: You gain resistance to Bludgeoning damage equal to 2 times your attunement rank.

  • Rank 2: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberSignaraAttu signaraStudiousCounter] action which imposes a Bane on every action a known enemy takes against you.

  • Rank 3: Your Willpower defense is increased by 1 per attunement rank above 2.

  • Rank 4: You unlock the Signaran spellcraft inflection which may be applied to spells that use the Control rune. On a critical hit, you immediately gain +2 Action, once per turn.

  • Rank 5: You unlock the @Action[Compendium.ember.crucible-character.Item.emberSignaraAttu signaraImpartTruth] action which restores the lucidity of an insane creature or shatters the morale of a sane one.

signaraStudiousCounter.name: Studious Counter
signaraStudiousCounter.description: You direct your focus toward a specific enemy, working to counter its every maneuver. If you have Knowledge of the creature's type, any action it takes until the start of your next Turn that targets you suffers +1 Bane. Additionally, while studied, your Signaran-inflected spells and the Impart Truth action gain +1 Boon against this target.
signaraStudiousCounter.condition: You have Knowledge of the target creature's type.

signaraImpartTruth.name: Impart Truth
signaraImpartTruth.description: You connect with the mind of a creature that is @Condition[insane] and it becomes entirely lucid, receiving restoration to Madness and Morale that sets each resource to half of its maximum value. If your target was not @Condition[insane], it suffers an attack against its Willpower that, if successful, reduces it to 0 Morale and leaves it @Condition[broken]. This action scales with your highest ability of Wisdom, Presence, or Intellect, and gains +1 Boon when used on the target of your current Studious Counter.

Signborn Lineage.name: Signborn Lineage
Signborn Lineage.description:
You have two ethereal arms in addition to your corporeal limbs. These arms may not wield weapons, shields, or other equipment. They can be used, however, to quickly manipulate items in addition to your regular limbs. Once per Round you may equip an Item from your inventory without spending any @Rule[resource.action] points to do so.

Using special Signborn language and physiology, you synchronize your ethereal limbs into the weaving of spellcraft to effortlessly perform feats of magic. You know the unique Glyphspeak inflection which can be added to spells. A spell augmented with Glyphspeak costs +1 @Rule[resource.heroism] to cast, but can be performed at a reduced cost of -2 @Rule[resource.action].

Soulbound.name: Soulbound
Soulbound.description:
You have died and are now Soulbound, afflicted by a magical tether called a Soulmark that prevents your spirit from passing on according to the typical Soul Cycle of Ember. You are not undead and you retain the features you had during life, but your continued existence is subject to additional rules with consequences that worsen as the strength of your Soulmark grows.

There are three Soulbound ranks which impose the following Soulmarks in sequence: "Lesser", "Greater", and "Deathly". Each rank imposes progressively more severe effects.

Your maximum Madness value is reduced as you are more susceptible to the mind-consuming influence of undeath.

  • Lesser Soulmark: Reduced by 2 per Level

  • Greater Soulmark: Reduced by 4 per Level

  • Deathly Soulmark: Reduced by 6 per Level

Your Morale Threshold and Healing Threshold defenses increase, making you harder to heal.

  • Lesser Soulmark: Increased by 2

  • Greater Soulmark: Increased by 4

  • Deathly Soulmark: Increased by 6

Creatures of the Outsider, Undead, and Monstrosity types gain Boons to Awareness checks to sense you.

  • Lesser Soulmark: 1 Boon

  • Greater Soulmark: 2 Boons and you can be seen while @Condition[invisible]

  • Deathly Soulmark: 3 Boons and you can be seen while @Condition[invisible]

All Skill actions which target a creature of the Beast type incur one bane as animals are inherently wary and distrusting of you.

  • Lesser Soulmark: 1 Bane

  • Greater Soulmark: 2 Banes

  • Deathly Soulmark: 3 Banes

Uses of the Diplomacy skill towards creatures of the Humanoid type incur banes resulting from your gruesome nature:

  • Lesser Soulmark: 1 Bane

  • Greater Soulmark: 2 Banes

  • Deathly Soulmark: 3 Banes

When you die, your Soulbound Rank increases by one, progressing from Lesser to Greater or from Greater to Deathly. If you die while bearing a Deathly Soulmark, you become an undead creature under the Gamemaster's control.

Tactical Planner.name: Tactical Planner
Tactical Planner.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Exceptional Taste.name: Exceptional Taste
Exceptional Taste.description: Your attire is more powerful a tool in your handling of social situations than any blade or spell. When you are wearing clothing of at least Fine quality that is not Broken, you gain +2 Boons to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation skill checks.

Thornling Lineage.name: Thornling Lineage
Thornling Lineage.description:
The fibrous biology of Thornlings is incredibly resilient, providing the following benefits:

  • Your @Rule[defense.armor] defense cannot be below 6 regardless of what type of equipment you are wearing.

  • Damage taken from @Rule[actions.fall]{Falling} is reduced by half before other resistances apply.

thornbark.name: Thornbark
thornbark.description:
When you are targeted by a melee attack, you can cause thorny barbs to extrude from your body. For one minute you gain the following benefits.

  • Melee attacks which Hit or Glance you wound the attacker in retaliation who suffers damage equal to your @Rule[ability.toughness] ability score.

  • Attempts to Grapple or Push you suffer +2 Banes.

The effects of this Action apply to the attack which triggered the reaction.

ALPHA ONE: The effects of Thornbark are not yet fully automated.
thornbark.condition: You are targeted by a melee attack.

Undaunted Warrior.name: Undaunted Warrior
Undaunted Warrior.description: You have extraordinary bravery and training for facing monstrous foes. You gain +1 Boon on any attack against enemies of the Monstrosity type.

Urban Resourcefulness.name: Urban Resourcefulness
Urban Resourcefulness.description: BETA TWO: This talent is not updated with Crucible mechanics yet.

Vrjnhar Lineage.name: Vrjnhar Lineage
Vrjnhar Lineage.description: When an attack against you results in a Glance, you protect yourself by taking the blow upon your magnificent beard which fully protects you from the damage otherwise dealt by a glancing blow.

formidableStamina.name: Formidable Stamina
formidableStamina.description: You draw upon incredible reserves of energy to keep fighting past the point of exhaustion. For a period of time, whenever you exhaust your pool of @Rule[resource.action] points, you have a 25% chance to immediately recover one @Rule[resource.action] point.

Wirrun Lineage.name: Wirrun Lineage
Wirrun Lineage.description:
You are immune to the effects of extreme cold. Your vision is not impaired by fog, mist, snow, or other atmospheric effects.

Alpha One: This vision effect is not yet automated.

implacableHunter.name: Implacable Hunter
implacableHunter.description:
You designate one creature you can see as your quarry.

  • You gain +2 Boons to any @Rule[skill.awareness] or @Rule[skill.wilderness] roll which pertains to identifying its location.

  • When you move closer to your quarry on your turn, you gain +2 Boons on the next attack roll made against your quarry on that same turn.

Zeph Lineage.name: Zeph Lineage
Zeph Lineage.description:
Your body is a swirling gale bound to the mask at its core. When you die, only your mask remains, and it counts as your physical remains for the purposes of spells or magical effects which target a deceased creature.

After you @Rule[actions.rest], you may shape your mask into one of three visages, which it holds until you shape another.

windborneEscape.name: Windborne Escape
windborneEscape.description:
Magical winds of the Storm rune mingle with your body, which disperses into the gale and reconstitutes somewhere nearby. You move up to your Stride without spending @Rule[resource.action] or your free movement, and this movement does not provoke any @Action[default reactiveStrike].

As you reform, you are freed from the @Condition[overrun], @Condition[prone], @Condition[restrained], @Condition[slowed], @Condition[staggered], and @Condition[stunned] conditions. You may use this action while @Condition[restrained].

inscrutableVisage.name: Inscrutable Visage
inscrutableVisage.description: Your mask settles into an unreadable calm. You gain +2 Boons to @Rule[skill.deception] checks and +1 to your @Rule[defense.reflex] defense.

menacingVisage.name: Menacing Visage
menacingVisage.description: Your mask hardens into a fearsome scowl. You gain +2 Boons to @Rule[skill.intimidation] checks and +1 to your @Rule[defense.fortitude] defense.

beguilingVisage.name: Beguiling Visage
beguilingVisage.description: Your mask softens into a warm, disarming smile. You gain +2 Boons to @Rule[skill.diplomacy] checks and +1 to your @Rule[defense.willpower] defense.

Flameguard Militia.name: Flameguard Militia
Flameguard Militia.description:
The fight against the undead pouring from the Moiran lands and attacking the Lumek Homelands affects the entire world. Nations across the world send capable fighters and soldiers to help assist the beleaguered Flameguard. You may never have seen combat, instead focusing on organizing defenses and training. It's likely, however, that you stood your ground against the never-ending hordes of undead on the front lines with a torch in one hand and a shield in the other.

You know some of the different types of Undead, their weaknesses, and you can generally conduct yourself well in combat. Because of your exposure to undeath, you likely also have extremely limited awareness of the Shroud.

Origin Stories

Carry the Fire. Since leaving the Flameguard, you have made it your mission to carry Lumé's cleansing fire to distant lands and instill it in the hearts of ordinary people. Following troubling reports of rising shades, your travels now take you to a land whose people have little conception of the undead. It is your responsibility to teach them.

Bring the Steel Home. A weapon made of Lumarin Steel was lost outside the Lumarin Homelands, carried away by a fleeing soldier, taken from the remains of a battlefield, or sold by someone who did not understand the value of what they had. To the Lumek, such a weapon is not merely valuable; the ashes of the faithful dead are folded into the steel, so that it may bear their memories into the future. You are searching for it, to return it home or to use it yourself for its intended purpose.

Find the Deserter. You were assigned to a remote outpost with a group of raw recruits. When the undead probed the outpost's defenses, one of the recruits broke ranks and ran, leaving others to die and you gravely injured. Once the ashes of your fallen charges had cooled, you swore to find the deserter. Rumors place them somewhere far from the Lumarin Homelands, where they have taken a new identity.

Imperial Conscript.name: Imperial Conscript
Imperial Conscript.description:
Visiting or living in the Tayan Empire can be perilous, as they care little about where their conscripts come from. You may have been forcibly conscripted or spent time training with the military only to escape and cross oceans as a deserter, or perhaps you were injured and discharged from service after an intense battle. You have all the basic knowledge of a conscript or soldier: how to handle a weapon, strategize, and survive the horrors of a battlefield. You may also have limited knowledge of Dragons from brief encounters with one or more Tayan Dragon riders, such as the Empress herself or one of the other rare Kirargy Knights who bonded with one.

You have a deep knowledge of warfare, can quickly recognize logistical and organizational problems, and can strategize and plan for various situations. You also know some about Dragons and are aware of the different types and their traits.

Origin Stories

Flee the Directorate. You have been marked as a traitor to the Empire. Perhaps you deserted an unwinnable battle or publicly voiced a critical opinion of the Empress. Whatever the reason, you were forced to flee across the sea, and now you find yourself far from home, hoping to build a new life. You must remain vigilant, however; the Directorate's agents have a long reach and even longer memories.

Break the Machine. You were forcibly conscripted into a war you did not choose, and over the course of your service, you witnessed hundreds of lives fed into the Empire's war machine. Though you miraculously survived, you are haunted by the faces of those who did not. You seek to spread dissent against the Tayan Empire and disrupt their plans wherever possible; no one should be forced to suffer as you have.

Chasing Dragons. Once, on a battlefield choked by blood and Aethyric vapor, you thought you were sure to meet your end — until a dragon rider passed overhead and cleansed the line with a breath of fire. Whether it was the Empress herself or one of her Kirargy Knights, you cannot forget the terrible majesty you beheld. You follow rumors of dragons: ancient remains, scorched evidence of their passing, or even a living creature to learn more about them and record the knowledge for others.

Lightsworn.name: Lightsworn
Lightsworn.description:
The shining distant light of Luxarum has filled your soul with glorious songs since you were a child, and you have sworn to discover its secrets. You believe you have even met one of the shining beings known as Tyraphem from Luxarum in a rare but blinding event that left you awestruck, and you swore to serve them. Upon your death in this mortal realm after serving the desires of your master or mistress or learning more about the light, you know with absolute certainty that you will be rewarded with eternal life in the Golden Realm above.

You have limited knowledge of the Inner Realm of Luxarum, the Tyraphem who rule over it, and their servants, the celestials. This knowledge may be warped by your own perception or zeal and may differ from the truth you find in the world.

Origin Stories

Find the Fallen Light. A fragment of golden light fell upon the surface world, or so your dreams insist. This fragment may be a relic, a wounded celestial creature, a place touched by the light of Luxarum, or a test of faith placed before you by powers beyond your comprehension. Whatever it is, you have followed its brilliance thus far, and you will not turn back until you find it.

Overwhelming Radiance. Your interaction with a radiant Tyraphem left you devoted and fanatical to spread the light to every corner of the world. You abhor even the barest glimmer of evil and hold yourself to a rigid, relentless philosophy: only those who are truly good deserve to live. You now seek opportunities to prove yourself worthy of the Golden Realm and will confront all who oppose the glorious light of Luxarum.

Confront the Shroud. You have beheld the corruption of true darkness and are distantly aware of the horrors lurking behind the Weave. Despite this vague understanding, you have fortified your mind with the help of light, and you oppose the madness with every fiber of your being. You seek to destroy all knowledge of the Shroud, in every book, ruin, or within those already corrupted by its influence. You must destroy any monsters or creatures of eldritch horror you encounter with radiant fire.

Lunar Empath.name: Lunar Empath
Lunar Empath.description:
You are deeply connected to the people around you and can sense a person's mood or emotions with a mere glance. You have such an uncanny ability to read people that some believe you can read their innermost thoughts. You may have also used your abilities to become akin to a local mystic, perhaps reading palms or decks of cards to tell people's fortunes.

You understand other mortal beings empathically, able to put yourself directly in other people's shoes and see through their eyes. You also have some knowledge of the Elemental moons and the effects their cycles and orbits have upon the surface world.

Origin Stories

Find the Silent Mind. Most people are easy to read, but someone you met was different: their emotions were absent, hidden behind a hollow void in your mind that you have never forgotten. You have taken to the road to find them again, and discover whether their condition is something to be understood … or feared.

Soothe the Lands. The surface world is a land of strained emotions, deep wounds, and old griefs that its communities have never learned to put down. You feel those burdens as if they were your own, and believe your gift can help people navigate the ebb and flow of fear and anger that the Elemental Moons so often draw to the surface. You are drawn to elemental areas and lodestones of power, trying to quiet them and return them to peace.

A Lonely Pilgrimage. Your mind has always felt different to those around you, and although you desperately seek connection, you can't help but carry the burdens of those close to you. You have been seeking a sacred site for some time, a place where you can perform the Rite of the Pale Reflection, submerged in an undisturbed font of lunar energy to purge the accumulated emotional detritus.

Monster Hunter.name: Monster Hunter
Monster Hunter.description:
You may have once led a simple life, but everything changed when the monsters in the darkness attacked and broke through your community's defenses. You now hate Ember's aberrations and monsters with burning fury and hunt them across the world. Alternatively, you may have been taught from an early age how to hunt monsters and know exactly how to track and destroy them wherever they may appear.

You are a capable survivalist, spending days or even weeks scouring the wilderness, and you can read the subtle tracks of many different creatures and monsters. You can identify Monsters more easily than others and may even know some of their weaknesses. 

Origin Stories

Hunt a Monster. You have heard stories of many terrible monsters emerging onto the surface world following a series of earthquakes, leaving crushed homesteads, broken hillsides, and terrified witnesses in their wake. You have been tracking the rumors for some time, and you relish the chance to track the largest, most ferocious monster you can find and take its head as a trophy.

Monsters in the Plateau. Strange, mutated monsters have begun appearing across the Arctus Plateau, aberrant things that appear ill and malformed. These creatures may seem random to frightened villagers, but you know better: where there is a pattern, there is a cause, and you mean to find out what it is.

Cursed Mark. The monster came at night, and by morning your old life was gone, your family dead and your mind wracked with guilt and unending vengeance. You never saw what it was, but its claws and teeth left deep scars in your skin. Since then, you have followed signs of its passing throughout the world. The trail has picked up again, and somewhere nearby, your quarry awaits.

Natural Artisan.name: Natural Artisan
Natural Artisan.description:
Many skilled and experienced crafters work throughout the known world, but none are more renowned for their dedication and legacy than the Arcturians of the Arctus Plateau. You have spent many years learning from their techniques and traditional knowledge. You know how to handcraft items from wood and other natural materials like fibers and loam to create practical yet beautiful forms; you also understand construction and how buildings are assembled.

You understand how to build and craft items traditionally using wood and natural materials from the earth. You also have some understanding of plant life and the natural world.

Origin Stories

A Living Helper. You have long been fascinated by the Arcturian tradition of fabricating small, autonomous companions from wood, fiber, loam, and magic. Most artisans relegate these creatures to mundane tasks, but you seek to create something greater: a fully sentient companion capable of thought, imagination, and purpose.

Study Agrimagic. The Arcturians created Agrimagic by applying spellcraft to the needs of the land and its people. You have come to the Arctus Plateau to study that tradition, whether as an eager magical apprentice, a skeptical outsider, or a lay craftsperson hoping to bring agrimagic back home.

Catalog Architecture. The Arctus Plateau is home to a wide variety of places built in harmony with the land, and your goal is to catalog the methods by which they were built before they are irrevocably changed by the tide of progress or the rumored chaos that has beset the region. Every homestead, garden, and community is a record of practical knowledge, and you mean to preserve that record.

Nightwatch.name: Nightwatch
Nightwatch.description:
The colossal and ancient Kelmezian city-states are mortal-made mountains, built in layers atop one another to create settlements with vast populations. Most of their layers are almost ungovernable, especially as you delve deeper, and only the furious dedication of the group called the Nightwatch, who prowl the causeways and alleyways, has any hope of keeping the peace. You may have once trained with members of the Nightwatch or helped with their endless forays into the depths, learning how to blend into the darkness and move like lightning through an urban environment.

You know how to investigate all manner of strange occurrences, like crimes, or follow threads of conspiracy. You may also have an innate ability to gather information from corpses or mortal bodies and determine what killed them.

Origin Stories

Hunt the Fugitive. You once pursued a killer through the lower layers of a Kelmezian city, across causeways, over rooftops, and through tunnels that had not seen sunlight in generations. The killer escaped the city before you could finish your work, but rumors now place them in this region under another name.

Evade Capture. The hunter has become the hunted: framed for a crime you did not commit, you were forced to flee the Kelmezian City States. Your fellow comrades in the Nightwatch will pursue you with fanatical intensity. One day, they will catch you. But not today.

Trace the Conspiracy. In the lowest depths of Old Carinth, you began to trace the edges of a conspiracy that seemed to span the world, one involving Shard Gods, strange alchemical compounds, and corrupt politicians. Though your superiors called you mad, you felt compelled to leave Old Carinth behind and take your investigation abroad.

Obsidian Antiquary.name: Obsidian Antiquary
Obsidian Antiquary.description:
The distant, sun-bathed continent of Kessia, far to the south, holds dangerous wonders and ancient secrets. Those who travel the windswept depths of the corrupted Obsidian Desert are brave and foolish in equal measure. You may be fascinated by ancient, terrible secrets and the artifacts unearthed in the black sands. You may have spent years traversing the desert searching for answers or collecting and studying the desert and its secrets from afar. You have likely discovered terrifying truths from your research and have been mentally scarred by their effects. 

You know of the Shroud and its rarer, deadlier name: the Abyss. You can determine the properties of some ancient magical artifacts. You are also aware of the healing and radiant energy of Lantyr that seems to oppose Abyssal energies.

Origin Stories

Heal Thyself. You have handled enough corrupted relics to know some wounds don't heal with time. Yet you have also seen Lantyr's radiant power weaken the strange influence clinging to objects recovered from the black sands. If Lantyr's light can cleanse an object, why not the soul? You seek the favor of Lantyr herself, hoping a great deed will cleanse your soul of madness.

The Black Glass. You have spent years cataloging relics pulled from the Obsidian Desert, learning to recognize the subtle marks left by whatever corruption poisoned the land. Recently, an artifact you recovered crossed your path bearing those same signs, even though you found it far from Kessia. You are trying to discover how something touched by the desert could have traveled so far — or whether that same corruption lies somewhere nearby. You still carry this shard of Black Glass, and every day the whispers eat away at your mind as you search for answers.

A Cursed Archive. Convinced the Abyss whispering in your mind is a fragmented cosmic prophecy, you hunt down artifacts not to destroy them, but to piece them together and reveal the secrets needed to stave off a horrific future. To keep your mind from unraveling into absolute madness, you must constantly travel from place to place, seek out every cursed artifact you can, and study them in detail, despite the dangers to your psyche.

Primalist Disciple.name: Primalist Disciple
Primalist Disciple.description:
Deep beneath the colossal trees of the Corebright Forest at the center of the known world prowl the shapeshifting and nature-worshipping Primalists. You may have spent time wandering the edges of the forest, and you may have even encountered a Primalist who taught you about their beliefs and how to commune with animals in some fashion. You may also have learned about the numerous ancient Leviathans that still rule vast sections of the world, and through your connection to nature, you can sense and understand them better than the average mortal.

You can understand animals and beasts to some degree and have an innate connection to the natural world. In addition, you have some knowledge of Leviathans.

Origin Stories

Seek the Sleeping Leviathan. During your time with the Primalists, you learned that Leviathans are not distant myths, but creatures who still live among mortals, sequestered in the shadowed places of the world. While you have never seen one yourself, you are determined to find one, learn what you can, and decide whether to awaken its power or let it lie.

Wildsong Listener. You have always felt a deep connection to the Wildsong, the music of the natural world itself, and have followed its melodies wherever they led you. But recently the song has become strange and discordant. The Wild Gods that compose the song are distant or lost, at war with enemies both within and without. To ease their suffering, you must seek the source of their despair.

Advocate for Nature. You have heard stories of earthquakes wracking the Arctus Plateau, of the land being rent apart, and of colossal, subterranean beasts emerging onto the surface world. To you, these are not isolated disasters, but warnings from nature itself. You must advocate for the natural world where possible, and seek to stem the tide of chaos and destruction.

Scion of Darkness.name: Scion of Darkness
Scion of Darkness.description:
Some say that darkness is simply the absence of light, but those people are fools, and you know better. Darkness is a force as powerful and seductive as any other, and you have found yourself drawn to lightless places. In search of understanding, you may have found ways to summon a Fiend and make a pact with it in exchange for knowledge and power, and you are committed to serving its goals as you prowl the mortal world. Your pact means that upon your death, you will be granted eternal life upon the dark realm of Signara and will be able to study mysteries or engage in endless feuds and games to your heart's content. 

You have limited knowledge of the Inner Realm of Signara, the Daemos who rule its darkened halls, and their servants, the Fiends. This knowledge may be warped by your own perception or twisted understanding and may differ from the truth you find in the world.

Origin Stories

Collect a Soul. Someone made a pact with your patron and broke the terms, fleeing with valuable knowledge. You have been sent to find them, punish them, and, if possible, re-bind their soul to your patron. But one question has begun to gnaw at you: what will you decide to do if they share the secret of their escape?

Play the Game. Your patron has many rivals among the Daemos and Fiends, and you have been sent to track down their servants. You have been commanded to counter their games and plots, humiliate their servants, and prove that your patron is the cleverer one. Victory will earn you rewards in your afterlife on Signara; failure will leave your soul at the mercy of your patron's rival.

Prove Darkness Is Not Evil. Signara is many things: vast, cold, dark, and a keeper of vast secrets. But the Endless Dark is not inherently wicked, whatever certain priests and frightened villagers may claim. You have seen servants of so-called light commit cruelties that no true student of Signara would ever consider. You must walk openly as a servant of darkness and prove that cold comfort can be found in Signara's comforting dark.

Shadow Walker.name: Shadow Walker
Shadow Walker.description:
Wherever light and darkness exist, so do shadows, and ever since you were young, you have found stalking silently between trees or buildings to be as natural as breathing. You find yourself particularly at peace during dusk and dawn, where the twilight light is comforting and alluring. At some point in your life, you may have come across another being in the shadows, a mysterious Fae that taught you even greater abilities in return for whispered servitude, or you found yourself in front of a glimmering portal that you could not pass through despite your desperate pleas. Nevertheless, you believe that you will be granted access and rewarded with eternal life in the Shadowlands upon your death.

You have limited knowledge of the Inner Realm of Primordis, the Casia stalk the shadow thickets, and their servants, the Fae. This knowledge may be warped by your own perception or illusions and may differ from the truth you find in the world.

Origin Stories

Enter Primordis. Years ago, you discovered a glimmering portal beneath the boughs of an ancient tree, and begged whatever lay beyond it to let you pass. The portal did not admit you, but each attempt revealed a little more: a cyclopean forest, strange creatures of shadow, and the impression of hungering things in the dark. Through your studies, you have come to know this place as Primordis, and you have searched for an entrance ever since.

The Fae Patron. A Fae once found you in a dire predicament. Perhaps you were imprisoned or cornered in the wilderness by a starving beast. Whatever the circumstance, this Fae creature deigned to shield you in shadow and slip you away from danger. In return, it occasionally asks small services of you: whispering messages to sleeping strangers, unlocking doors at dusk, obscuring tracks before dawn. Now it has sent you forth with uncharacteristic urgency; somehow, an old foe has escaped the First Forest, and you must track it down.

Become the Hunter. Strange shadows hunted you in your youth, and you learned early to cloak yourself in those same shadows and silence; within the shadows, you began to hear whispers from Primordis, guiding your steps, your hands, your thoughts. The voices granted you the power to protect yourself, but you fear that their preternatural hunger has infected you. You are no longer hunted — no longer prey — but in becoming the hunter, have you lost something else?

Shard God Devotee.name: Shard God Devotee
Shard God Devotee.description:
Enthralled by the stories of Shard Gods who walk the world with their followers, you have become obsessed with becoming a servant of the gods one day. You may be deeply religious and hold to the tenets and teachings of a particular deity, hailing from the commune of a distant Shard God or one of their temples. Alternatively, you may want to worship a particular Shard God directly and meet them in the flesh, and you may be searching for meaning and faith in a dangerous world.

Your faith has granted you knowledge of many different deities, god-like beings, and powerful entities, as well as their varied religious practices.

Origin Stories

Seek a Shard God. Distant worship has never satisfied you. You have been searching all your life for a living, breathing god, one who walks the world with their own feet, accepts offerings with their own hands, and speaks commandments in their own voice. You may be following reports of a specific Shard God, or merely following whatever trail presents itself.

Become a Shard God. You know that Shard Gods are born of mortals, ascendants, and bearers of great power. If the Shard Gods were once something less than divine, then perhaps those brave or lucky enough to uncover it can achieve divinity. You have been searching for the knowledge of divinity and the methods to achieve ascendancy. Perhaps along your journey you will have the opportunity to ask a Shard God in person.

Test False Divinity. Rumors have reached your ears of chaos and destruction, great acts of magic that have swept across the world. Your divine patron appears in a vivid dream, urging you to distinguish truth from falsehood, miracles from trickery, and divinity from eldritch greed. Only the worthy can truly claim to be a god, and you will test their claims, punishing those who worship false gods.

Sky Wanderer.name: Sky Wanderer
Sky Wanderer.description:
You are driven ever onward to explore the distant horizon; a powerful sense of freedom and never-ending skies fills your soul. You are a trader of exceptional skill, able to travel across vast distances without care nor worry, and you have an innate appreciation and understanding of material items and their worth. You may draw your free spirit from the ancient legends and myths of the Vaznor and their flying cities of clouds and sail.

You have extremely limited knowledge of the lost Vaznor culture. You are also a skilled trader who can barter for almost any available goods or wares, and you have an innate understanding of weather.

Origin Stories

Find a Fallen City. You grew up hearing stories of the Vaznor, a winged people whose cities sailed among the clouds before plummeting from the sky and vanishing from history. Most dismiss such tales as old myths, but fragments of strange masonry are occasionally found far from any known settlement. You have followed rumors of such fragments, hoping to find a fallen city and learn what became of the people who once lived high above the world.

Storm Chaser. You have always understood weather instinctively, and soon developed a particular fascination with storms — especially the destructive power they hold. Lately, you have heard reports of impossible storms moving across the Arctus Plateau, ones born not of nature, but of arcane energy. If these storms can be understood, then perhaps they can be controlled.

Reach the Horizon. "What lies beyond the ragged edges of the world?" This is the question that has fascinated you since childhood, and so far, you have not found a satisfactory answer. The world's vast, inhospitable oceans have pushed its furthest reaches beyond mortal exploration. Perhaps the Vaznor, with their flying cities, knew the truth; you must search the remnants of their fallen civilization to find out.

Star Dreamer.name: Star Dreamer
Star Dreamer.description:
You have always been enamored with the dreaming worlds you find yourself in when you sleep. The Sea of Stars reaches out to wrap you in its embrace, and the glittering Stars themselves murmur softly with strange stories, granting you visions of distant places, times, and events. You may have even been guided in these dreams by giant figures who give you mysterious portents or signs, drawing beautiful, shining runes in the air around them. You may have spent time studying these dreams and discovered that the giant figures could well be the remaining ancient memories of the Shent, a lost people that met their end thousands of years ago.  

Your dreams and studying have granted you some knowledge of the ancient Shent Culture, and you have excellent knowledge of the Stars in the night sky and their patterns. You may also have some knowledge of prophecy and may have some limited future sight yourself.

Origin Stories

Follow the Dream.
