For weeks, you have dreamt of the same place: a ruined tower beneath a sky that flows like an ocean, a giant figure tracing shining runes through the air, and something terrible waiting just beyond your sight. Each night, the vision grows clearer; you have followed its portents to this region, hoping to discover whether the dream foretells something yet to happen or something that already has.

Find the Shent. A towering figure has visited your dreams since childhood, speaking in a language you cannot understand and showing you fragments of a civilization lost during the Shattering. You believe this presence is the memory of a Shent who somehow survived their people's destruction. Their visions have led you to the Arctus Plateau, where you hope to learn who they were in life — and what they want from you now.

The Fallen Star. A star vanished from the night sky, and on the same night you dreamt of something blazing through the Sea of Stars toward Ember. Since then, your sleep has been filled with images of scorched earth, storms of strange magic, and a light buried in stone. You have followed those visions here, hoping to find whatever fell before someone else does.

Sunfire Descendant.name: Sunfire Descendant
Sunfire Descendant.description:
Your family has kept a long, shameful secret for uncounted generations; you descend from the infamous legacy of the ancient Aedir. Your family may have once served the Aedir or been part of the culture in some way, or your Ancestors may have somehow remarkably survived the events of the Shattering. You now hold ancient secrets of the Sunfire Empire of the Aedir, which once ruled the world of Ember, and you can recognize the ruins and artifacts left behind after it fell. You may hold a family heirloom yourself or have been taught an ancient secret phrase. 

You have extremely limited knowledge of the lost Aedir culture, can determine the properties of some ancient magical artifacts, and are highly adept at keeping secrets and intrigue.

Origin Stories

Reclaim a Legacy. You bear the heavy weight of an ancient bloodline, despised by most of the world for causing the Shattering. Throughout your life, you have kept your lineage a secret, but you are determined to unearth the Aedir's secrets to prove your people were not the arrogant monsters everyone claims they were.

Hunting the Deceivers. While other descendants carry guilt and shame, your soul burns with rage against those who have twisted the Aedir's legacy. You have heard rumors of those who not only wish to restore the Sunfire Empire but also to twist it to their unholy ends. You will stop at nothing to find them and destroy them in the name of your once-proud and noble forebears. 

Unearth the Secret. Your family once told you of a long-kept secret of the Aedir, a magical energy source said to power all of the empires' technology. Lost to time for thousands of years, anyone who finds it would be able to command the overwhelming might of their armies, weapons, and magic, and you have been searching for it ever since.

Underworld Mechanic.name: Underworld Mechanic
Underworld Mechanic.description:
You have survived or spent time in the underbelly of one of the world's greatest mysteries, the colossal city structure known as the Sphere. You learned how to repair, maintain, and construct all manner of machines, devices, and contraptions. This includes constructs, as well as devices that produce power or perform wondrous engineering feats akin to magic. Unfortunately, you may have also lived a life of crime, doing anything to survive the gang-based politics that plague the murky darkness you once called home, and learned some more questionable skills along the way.

You know many types of machines, and you can fix, repair, or maintain them more easily than other mortals. You can also recognize traps and have an innate ability to handle yourself in dangerous situations.

Origin Stories

Escaping the Underworld. You survived the Sphere's labyrinthine layers by repairing machines for whoever could afford you, and for a time you enjoyed a measure of success—but if you stay in the game long enough, you've got to lose, and you lost big. You tampered with something you never should have found, and you were forced to flee. Unfortunately, someone or something from the Sphere seems to have followed you.

Understand the Sphere. Everyone in the Sphere learns to live around its alien machines. You learned to coax secret corridors open, wake dormant constructs, and keep ancient mechanisms pumping, but none of that told you who built the place, or why. Tired of being surrounded by incurious minds, you set out to find the truth in distant lands among those with knowledge of the past and the secrets of the cosmos.

Trace the Parts. You spent years keeping pieces of the Sphere alive without ever understanding what they were built to do. Recently, you saw sketches of an ancient mechanism, built with components shockingly similar to those buried deep in the Sphere. You have come to find this mechanism and determine whether the resemblance is mere coincidence … or evidence that the Sphere is not as unique as everyone believes.
